description: This file defines a report module for Odoo (OpenERP), specifically generating a workcenter load report with custom date computations and PDF rendering.

classes.name: external_pdf
classes.description: A class for rendering external PDF content, inheriting from report.render.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A class implementing a custom report for workcenter load, with methods to compute date ranges and generate PDF charts.

methods.name: _compute_dates
methods.description: Computes date ranges based on the specified time unit ('month', 'week', or 'day') between start and stop dates.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates the report PDF by querying production data, computing date ranges, and plotting bar charts for workcenter load.

methods.name: _empty_graph
methods.description: Creates a placeholder graph indicating no production orders.
